name: AT-rich interaction domain 1B

function.text: ARID1B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 1B. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); Coffin-Siris syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Undifferentiated / dedifferentiated endometrial carcinoma; Biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: ARID1B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 1B. Based in part on similarity, it participates in transcriptional activation and repression of select genes by chromatin remodeling (alteration of DNA-nucleosome topology). It forms part of SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complexes that carry out key enzymatic activities, changing chromatin structure by altering DNA-histone contacts within a nucleosome in an ATP-dependent manner. It belongs to the neural progenitors-specific chromatin remodeling complex (npBAF complex) and the neuron-specific chromatin remodeling complex (nBAF complex).

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); Coffin-Siris syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARID1B have been reported in undifferentiated / dedifferentiated endometrial carcinoma, biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma, and angiosarcoma.
